summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Goldman Sachs Core Plus Bond ETF (GCPB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund seeks total return through capital appreciation and income by actively managing a diversified US bond portfolio. The ETF uses fundamental research to reach beyond investment-grade securities and manage the portfolio. GCPB was launched on Aug 7, 2026 and is issued by Goldman Sachs.
